text: No fire was detected at this rural property (ASSET-F08) between October 4 and November 3, 2026. Satellite sensors (VIIRS and MODIS) monitored the area daily, but no thermal anomalies were recorded within the asset boundary. However, small, short-lived, or cloud-obscured fires might not have been detected. The assessment does not confirm the absence of burned areas or determine the cause of any potential changes. Observations were based on NASA FIRMS data, which is reliable but not exhaustive for all fire scenarios.
